segments.text: I wonder whether the library will extend its hours during finals.
Hi, I'm here about my scholarship. I got an email saying that my payment has been put on hold.
Let me take a look. Ah, I see. The system says we haven't received your enrollment confirmation for next semester.
That's strange. I submitted it online two weeks ago, and I even got a receipt.
Do you still have it? Sometimes the upload fails even though the receipt is generated.
I think so. Yes, here, a screenshot on my phone.

Perfect. I can forward this to the finance office right now, and they'll release the payment within three working days. If you don't hear from them by Thursday, come back and we'll call them together.
Great. Thanks a lot. I was getting a bit anxious about rent.

items.q: Why does the student say she was "getting a bit anxious about rent"?
options: Her payment determines whether she can pay rent
items.explain: La beca retenida afecta su capacidad de pagar el alquiler (inferencia).
